import axios_api from"./axios";import{BASE_URL}from"./config";const host="".concat(BASE_URL,"/buyer/buyercustomer");// 전체 조회
export const getBuyerCustomer=async()=>{const res=await axios_api.get(host);return res.data;};// 등록
export const createBuyerCustomer=async formData=>{const res=await axios_api.post(host,formData);return res.data;};// 수정
export const updateBuyerCustomer=async(buyerNo,formData)=>{const res=await axios_api.put("".concat(host,"/").concat(buyerNo),formData);return res.data;};// 삭제
export const deleteBuyerCustomer=async buyerNo=>{const res=await axios_api.delete("".concat(host,"/").concat(buyerNo));return res.data;};
